about:
American Mobility Products, Inc., operating as AMP Kentucky, is headquartered in Campbellsville, Kentucky, with additional locations in Lexington and Louisville. The company provides medical equipment solutions across the Commonwealth.

AMP Kentucky supplies augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) speech-generating devices, sleep apnea and respiratory therapy equipment, and power mobility chairs. The company operates dedicated Sleep, Speech, and Respiratory teams, including licensed respiratory therapists, to support equipment selection, fitting, and ongoing compliance monitoring.

The company serves individuals with speech, sleep, respiratory, and mobility impairments, as well as healthcare providers and caregivers seeking durable medical equipment. Its customer base includes patients requiring AAC devices for communication, CPAP and BiPAP therapy for sleep apnea, and power wheelchairs or scooters for mobility independence.

AMP Kentucky states its goal is to offer high-quality, cost-effective medical equipment solutions that enable customers to achieve the highest possible quality of life, summarized by the tagline "Transforming Care. Elevating Lives."
